Parents who choose Qasif usually hope their child will grow to embody meteor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Qasif belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Meteor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qasif total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: قاصف
in_arabic.meaning: اسم فاعل من قصفت الشيء إذا حاده وبلغه
in_arabic.long_meaning: القاصف هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، ويعني الذي يقصفه الرعد أو السحاب، أو هو الذي يحد الشيء وبلغه، وهو اسم من أسماء الله عز وجل الواردة في القرآن الكريم، وقد ورد ذكره في سورة البقرة.

in_urdu.name: قاصف
in_urdu.meaning: قاصف کا مطلب ہے جو چیز کو حد تک پہنچاتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: قاصف اللہ تعالیٰ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے وہ جو کسی چیز کو اس کی حد تک پہنچاتا ہے، یا وہ جو اسے حد تک لے جاتا ہے، یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے، اور یہ صفت اللہ تعالیٰ کی قدرت اور فرامین کو ظاہر کرتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: क़ासिफ़
in_hindi.meaning: क़ासिफ़ का अर्थ है जो कुछ को उसकी हद तक पहुँचाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: क़ासिफ़ अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, और इसका अर्थ है वह जो किसी चीज़ को उसकी हद तक पहुँचाता है, या वह जो उसे सीमा तक ले जाता है, यह नाम कुरआन में उल्लेखित है, और यह अल्लाह की शक्ति और आदेशों को प्रकट करता है।

in_pashto.name: قاصف
in_pashto.meaning: قاصف دى هغه څه چې يو شي ته يې حد ته رسوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: قاصف د الله تعالى ښکلي نومونو څخه يو دی، او معنی يې دى هغه څه چې يو شي ته يې حد ته رسوي، يا هغه څه چې حد ته يې لېږدي، دا نوم په قرآن کريم کې ياد شوى دى، او دا د الله تعالى قدرت او حکمونه ښيي.

in_english.name: Qasif
in_english.meaning: Qasif means one who reaches or attains something
in_english.long_meaning: Qasif is one of the beautiful names of Allah, and it means one who reaches or attains something, or one who takes something to its limit. This name is mentioned in the Quran and reflects Allah's power and commandments. It signifies the attribute of Allah's capability to accomplish and achieve.

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name "Qasif" has its origins in classical Arabic language, where it refers to a meteor that is seen as a shooting star in the night sky. This name is widely used in the Arab world and beyond among Muslim communities as a unique given name for children, adding to the richness and diversity of Islamic names. Historically and culturally, the name "Qasif" is associated with the wonder and beauty of the night sky, representing a sense of mystery, inspiration, and awe.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the sighting of a "Qasif" or shooting star is often viewed as a celestial phenomenon that carries spiritual and symbolic significance. Some Muslims believe that each shooting star represents a single drop of sincere prayer that rises to Allah, the Almighty, from the earth. This concept highlights the connection between human beings and the divine, emphasizing the importance of sincere and devoted worship. Additionally, the name "Qasif" can be considered a reminder of the transient nature of life and the importance of pursuing spiritual growth and striving for moral and ethical excellence, as our existence is fleeting like a shooting star in the vast expanse of the universe.
